soldier: Head greyish yellow, frontal region grey with a blackish tinge, pilosity of the head capsule moderate and slightly dense. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.60–0.66, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frons flat. Labrum lanceolate, apex bluntly rounded, labral setae well developed, the apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all rather long. Mandibles slender and straight, apex pointed and slightly curved; mandible length 0.63–0.66 times head capsule length and 1.01–1.05 times head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum about at the anterior quarter, anterior lateral margins nearly parallel and then widening; waist region narrow, its sides broadly arcuate, waist constriction index 0.23–0.28. Pronotum nearly kidney-shaped, about 1.4–1.6 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave in the middle, the anterior deeper than the posterior; more than 20 long setae in the middle region.
